cat > /root/autodl-tmp/auto_backup_checkpoints.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
# 自动备份 8B 训练 checkpoint — 每 60 秒检查新 checkpoint 并备份

while true; do
    # CLS 8B seed123
    for ckpt in /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_repo_cls_8b_seed123_conda/checkpoint-*; do
        if [ -d "$ckpt" ]; then
            ckpt_name=$(basename $ckpt)
            if [ ! -d "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_backup_cls_8b_seed123/$ckpt_name" ]; then
                echo "$(date): Backing up CLS $ckpt_name"
                cp -r "$ckpt" "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_backup_cls_8b_seed123/$ckpt_name"
            fi
        fi
    done

    # CWM 8B
    for ckpt in /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_repo_cwm_8b_conda/checkpoint-*; do
        if [ -d "$ckpt" ]; then
            ckpt_name=$(basename $ckpt)
            if [ ! -d "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_backup_cwm_8b/$ckpt_name" ]; then
                echo "$(date): Backing up CWM $ckpt_name"
                cp -r "$ckpt" "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_backup_cwm_8b/$ckpt_name"
            fi
        fi
    done

    sleep 60
done
SCRIPT
